name: trail
description: The Trail Marks (story/trail_1 .. story/trail_5), the Carter's Rags, rebuilt from scratch for ROADMAP 49 (tools/blueprints/briefs/trail.md, REBUILD.md). One recipe draws all five (MARK=1..5). MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. Output goes to build/rebuild/trail/out; 'build' writes candidates (build/rebuild/trail/story), 'live' the live structure/story/trail_N.nbt (shipped 52.5, critic SHIP).

scripts.build: mkdir -p ../../../../build/rebuild/trail/story && for n in 1 2 3 4 5; do MARK=$n node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir ../../../../build/rebuild/trail/out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py trail story/trail_$n --candidate --nbt ../../../../build/rebuild/trail/out/trail-$n.nbt || exit 1; done
scripts.live: for n in 1 2 3 4 5; do MARK=$n node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir ../../../../build/rebuild/trail/out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py trail story/trail_$n --nbt ../../../../build/rebuild/trail/out/trail-$n.nbt || exit 1; done
